question: The appeal 'How's that?' is associated with ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**cricket**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'How's that?:-**

 
 
• **The appeal 'How's that?' is associated with cricket and is made by the fielding team to the umpire to ask whether the batsman is out or not out.**
 
• In cricket, the fielding team can appeal for various reasons such as caught behind, LBW (leg before wicket), stumped, hit wicket, and run-out. The umpire then makes a decision based on the appeal and the rules of the game.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Badminton:-**

 
 
• It is a racquet sport played by either two opposing players (singles) or two opposing pairs (doubles), who take positions on opposite halves of a rectangular court that is divided by a net.
 
• The game is won by scoring points by striking a shuttlecock with the racquet and landing it within the opposing side's half of the court.
 
 
 
• **Volleyball:-**
 
 
• It is a team sport in which two teams of six players are separated by a net.
 
• Each team tries to score points by grounding a ball on the other team's court under organized rules.
 
 
 
• **Hockey:-**
 
 
• It is a team sport in which two teams play against each other by trying to maneuver a ball or a puck into the opponent's goal using a hockey stick.
 
• It is played on various types of fields, such as natural grass, ice, or artificial turf.
